description: Indian numerology from VedicDost's software: mulank (root number from birth day), bhagyank (destiny number from full date) and namank (name number, Chaldean) if a name is given. Use for "my lucky number", "mulank bhagyank".

language.description: User language: hi, en, mr, gu, bn, ta, te or kn (default en). Text and links come in this language.

name: numerology
title: Numerology (mulank, bhagyank, namank)
